baseCommit: <sha the block runner checks out; overridden by --base-commit>

tasks.role: implementer | tester | reviewer | planner | worker | scout | debugger
tasks.objective: <the full task text the arm sees — self-contained>

notes: taskId needs the tsk_ prefix (src/domain/ids.ts); role must be a known AgentRole (src/domain/roles.ts); allowedModels validate against the LIVE catalog (cheap/premium aliases work for smoke, real provider/model ids for production blocks).
